com.repos1tory.cloudflared.name: cloudflared
com.repos1tory.cloudflared.blurb: Cloudflare Tunnel client running natively on jailbroken iOS: quick tunnels and HTTPS from the device, no companion server.

control.Name: cloudflared
control.Author: Cloudflare, Inc.; iOS port by repos1tory
control.Description:
Cloudflare Tunnel client for jailbroken iOS (arm64)
cloudflared as a native command-line tool for rootless jailbroken iOS.
Quick tunnels and named tunnels run directly on the device; no Mac or
companion server is required. The quick-tunnel wrapper adds a loopback
compatibility shim for the upstream provisioning request.

nodejs.name: Node.js
nodejs.blurb: upstream Node.js 22 with full JIT and WebAssembly, bundled npm and npx.

control.Description:
Node.js 22.19.0 runtime for jailbroken iOS arm64
Experimental upstream Node.js port with W^X JIT support for iOS.
Ships full JIT (TurboFan) + WebAssembly. The node/npm/npx wrappers pass
--predictable --single-threaded (safe process-wide mprotect W^X flips) and
--disable-wasm-trap-handler (avoids V8's 10GB guarded wasm-memory reservation,
which iOS's per-process VA cap rejects).

wrangler-ios.name: Wrangler
wrangler-ios.blurb: the Cloudflare Workers CLI (esbuild-wasm). deploy Workers straight from the device.

control.Description:
Cloudflare Wrangler CLI for jailbroken iOS arm64
API, authentication, and deployment CLI. Bundles esbuild-wasm (no native
esbuild binary needed) and defers workerd's unsupported-platform error so
deploy commands run on iOS. Authenticate with "wrangler login --device";
local "wrangler dev" is unavailable because Cloudflare workerd has no iOS
runtime build.
